title: Smothered Smoky Tofu
subtitle: with Chips and Corn-Studded Slaw
description: Love food that's smothered in sauce? We've got you covered, with pan-fried tofu coated in a smoky onion gravy, and potato chips to help you mop up every last drop.

steps.text: Roast chips: Preheat the oven to 220C. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Cut the unpeeled potatoes into 1cm-thick chips. Put the potato on the lined tray. Drizzle with 1 tbs olive oil, season with salt and pepper and toss to coat. Roast for 25 mins or until golden and tender.

Prep ingredients: Meanwhile, thinly slice the onion. Thinly slice the cabbage with a sharp knife or mandoline (see Kitchen 101). Peel the carrot, then shred using a julienne peeler or coarsely grate with a box grater. Discard the husk and silks from the corn. Put 1½ tbs mayonnaise and 1 tsp water in a large bowl, season with salt and pepper and stir to combine.

Char corn: Heat a medium frypan over high heat. Add the corn cob and 80ml (⅓ cup) water and cook, covered, for 5 mins. Turn the corn, add another 80ml (⅓ cup) water and cook, covered, for a further 5 mins or until lightly charred. Remove from the pan. Cool slightly, then slice the corn kernels from the cob.

Make gravy: Heat 1 tbs olive oil in the same pan over medium heat. Cook the onion, stirring occasionally, for 3-4 mins until softened. Add the smoky barbecue seasoning and 1 tbs plain flour and cook, stirring, for 30 secs. Add 180ml (¾ cup) water and 60ml (¼ cup) milk and stir to combine, then bring to the boil.

Serve up: Add the tofu to the gravy and cook, turning occasionally, for 2 mins or until warmed through. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Add the cabbage, carrot and corn to the mayonnaise mixture and toss to combine. Divide the tofu and gravy, chips and slaw among plates and enjoy!
Kitchen 101: Get super-thin cabbage with a mandoline or use slow, fine strokes with a large sharp knife. The result is perfect for slaw – light, crisp and easy to eat.
